{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with 'severe' disease (case-insensitive)
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'].str.lower() == 'severe']

# Filter out any baseline biomarker values equal to -999.0 (sentinel value)
valid_severe_patients = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinel values)
mean_biomarker_valid = valid_severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the final result
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among patients with severe disease (excluding sentinel values):", mean_biomarker_valid)"}
